name: Mafia Clash
desc:
🔪Your family is at WAR! Four rival families are competing for control of your city's underworld. Whose side will you take? Will you be a simple grunt, rise through the ranks to become the boss, or fight them as a cop? 🔪

⭐ CLAIM your COMMUNITY MEMBER role by joining the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/35589408

- 💰 Become the Boss and command real players to glory!
- 🧑‍🏭 Climb the ranks of your family with over 11 unique classes!
- ❤️ Steal and survive in a massive open world! 
- 👍 Enjoy the game? Leave a favorite and like to support the developers!

💬Check out the Social Links below to learn more about our community!
